target: Talkeven 1.0 for iOS and Android (language partners, plans and chat; no groups, no dating)

gates.name: Native typecheck, lint, domain and notification adapter tests
gates.evidence: npm run verify: typecheck, lint with zero warnings, 36 unit and 7 prototype tests (commit 6a0e27f).

gates.name: iOS and Android JavaScript bundle export
gates.evidence: npm run bundle:check, plus EAS iOS builds 4 to 6 and Android preview APKs built from the same tree.

gates.name: Native implementation of the v1 experience
gates.evidence: Discover, suggest a meetup (once or weekly), plans, chat, profile editing, block, report and delete account on the server callables (fad8c43 onward). Groups and dating are out of scope for v1.

gates.name: Server authorization, database rules and adversarial emulator tests
gates.evidence: Default deny rules and 16 callables; 86 emulator tests; deployed to duodialect-staging (Sydney) with a live two-account smoke test on 2026-09-26.

gates.name: Real account lifecycle, invitations, acceptance and chat
gates.evidence: Staging, 2026-09-26: full flow verified in the web build, and on an iPhone 14 (TestFlight build 7) with invitations, acceptance, chat and notifications against demo partner accounts. Remaining: an Android device run.

gates.name: Age controls, deletion, reporting and moderation
gates.evidence: Implemented: adult-only self-declared birth date, deletion cascade, reports and moderation queue with audit log. Published and checked live on 2026-10-05: talkeven.com privacy (names Lachlan Irving as operator), support (hello@talkeven.com, reply within two business days), delete-account and child-safety pages. Still to confirm: a test email reaching hello@.

gates.name: Installable signed iOS and Android builds meet current SDK requirements
gates.evidence: iOS: production build 8 (duodialect backend) processed by App Store Connect and submitted. Android: signed preview APK only; no AAB yet.

gates.name: Recorded tests on real iPhone and Android devices
gates.evidence: iPhone 14, TestFlight builds 5 to 7 (2026-09-26): login, onboarding, staying signed in, plans, chat, message and plan notifications, and tapping a notification from a closed app opening the chat all confirmed by Lachlan. No Android device yet.

gates.name: TestFlight and Google Play closed test completed and defects resolved
gates.evidence: TestFlight internal group 'Team' exists. Google Play app creation is blocked on Android device verification; the 12 tester, 14 day closed test applies (personal account created 2026-09-20).

gates.name: Accurate listing, policies, support, declarations and reviewer access
gates.evidence: iOS listing complete in App Store Connect (text, URLs at talkeven.com, 5 screenshots, 18+ age rating, published privacy labels, free, 148 territories excluding the EU, review account and notes).

gates.name: Final tested candidate approved for submission
gates.evidence: iOS 1.0 (build 8) submitted for App Review on 2026-09-26; state WAITING_FOR_REVIEW. Production backend deployed to duodialect (Sydney) and smoke tested.
